cues.en: Let's fiddle with our results a bit because as we've said, there are many ways to implement user-based and item-based collaborative filtering.
cues.zh: 稍微調整結果，因為如前所述，使用者式與項目式協同過濾，有很多實作方式。

cues.en: One thing we're doing that's kind of arbitrary is pulling off the top 10 highest rated items for a user, when generating item-based recommendations or the top 10 most similar users
cues.zh: 有一件事相當隨意：產生項目式推薦時，只取使用者評分最高的十個項目；產生使用者式推薦時，則取最相似的十位使用者。

cues.en: when finding user-based recommendations.
cues.zh: 就是這樣選出來源。

cues.en: That seems like kind of an arbitrary cutoff.
cues.zh: 這個截斷點似乎有點任意。

cues.en: Maybe it would be better if instead of taking the top case sources for recommendation candidates, we just used any source above some given quality threshold.
cues.zh: 也許，不取推薦候選的前 k 個來源，而是使用所有超過某個品質門檻的來源，會更好。

cues.en: For example, maybe any item a user rated higher than four stars, should generate item-based recommendation candidates no matter how many or how few of them there may be.
cues.zh: 例如，使用者給超過四顆星的任何項目，都應該產生項目式推薦候選，不管數量多寡。

cues.en: Or any user that has a cosine similarity greater than 0.95, should be used to generate candidates in the user-based recommendations.
cues.zh: 或是，任何餘弦相似度大於 0.95 的使用者，都用來產生使用者式推薦候選。

cues.en: This is a pretty easy change to make but if you're new to Python, it's a good learning experience.
cues.zh: 這個變更很容易做，但如果你是 Python 新手，會是不錯的學習經驗。

cues.en: Go give it a try and in the next slides, I'll show you how I did it.
cues.zh: 試試看，接下來的投影片會展示我的做法。

cues.en: So here's how I went about this.
cues.zh: 這是我的做法。

cues.en: I just commented out the existing line in simple item cf.py that generated the top K highest rated movies from our test user and replaced it with some simple code that goes through
cues.zh: 在 SimpleItemCF.py 中，先註解掉原本產生測試使用者評分最高前 k 部電影的那一行，再換成簡單程式碼，逐一檢查，

cues.en: and adds any rating above four stars to the list of movies that generate recommendation candidates.
cues.zh: 把所有超過四顆星的評分，加入用來產生候選推薦的電影清單。

cues.en: Here's a list of movie recommendations that item-bases similarities produced before making this change, where we used a top K approach.
cues.zh: 這是變更前，使用 Top-K 方法時，項目式相似度產生的電影推薦。

cues.en: And here's the list after this change.
cues.zh: 這是變更後的清單。

cues.en: It's hard to say which set of results is better but what's remarkable is how different these lists are.
cues.zh: 很難說哪組結果更好，但令人驚訝的是，兩份清單差異很大。

cues.en: We do see some of the same movies bubbling up to the top such as Get Real and Kiss of Death but our top pick on the left is totally gone on the right.
cues.zh: 仍有一些相同電影出現在前面，例如 Get Real 和 Kiss of Death，但左邊的第一名，右邊完全不見了。

cues.en: With this change, we've displayed some of the original results with different titles, such as Bean and Joe's Apartment.
cues.zh: 這次變更，以 Bean、Joe's Apartment 等不同片名，取代了部分原始結果。

cues.en: These replaced titles on the left include Wild Reeds and Fanny and Alexander.
cues.zh: 左邊被取代的片名，包括 Wild Reeds 和 Fanny and Alexander。

cues.en: It's interesting that I've actually heard of the new titles and never heard of the ones that got dropped.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，新增的片名我都聽過，被移除的卻沒聽過。

cues.en: So subjectively, it seems like this might be a promising change to test on real users.
cues.zh: 因此，主觀上，這似乎是值得拿真實使用者測試的變更。

cues.en: Let's have a look at how this same idea changes our results with user-based recommendations.
cues.zh: 看看同樣的想法，如何改變使用者式推薦的結果。

cues.en: Here's how I implemented the same idea on user-based collaborative filtering.
cues.zh: 這是我在使用者式協同過濾中，實作相同想法的方式。

cues.en: I commented out the line that's selected the top K users most similar to our test user and replaced it with code that builds up a list of arbitrary length of any users with a cosine similarity
cues.zh: 先註解掉選取與測試使用者最相似前 k 位使用者的那一行，再換成建立任意長度清單的程式碼，納入餘弦相似度

cues.en: score of 0.95 or higher.
cues.zh: 達 0.95 或更高的所有使用者。

cues.en: The results we started with look pretty compelling but let's have a look at the results we got when making this change.
cues.zh: 原本的結果看起來很有說服力，來看看變更後的結果。

cues.en: Again, it's hard to say which is better without testing it on real people at large scale but the thing that strikes me the most is that we seem to have lost recommendations for newer movies by making this change.
cues.zh: 同樣地，不對大量真實使用者測試，很難說哪個更好；但最讓我注意的是，這次變更後，似乎失去了較新電影的推薦。

cues.en: Again, that may just be a side effect of the time bias in our data set because we end up considering many more users than we did previously.
cues.zh: 這也可能只是資料集年代偏差的副作用，因為最後考慮的使用者，比之前多得多。

cues.en: Maybe 0.95 isn't a high enough threshold.
cues.zh: 也許 0.95 的門檻不夠高。

cues.en: Try a higher threshold like 0.98 and you'll find that newer movies such as The Dark Knight and Inception return to the results.
cues.zh: 試試 0.98 這種更高門檻，就會發現《黑暗騎士》、《全面啟動》等較新電影，又回到結果中。

cues.en: So again, we found a relatively small change that can make a huge difference in the results.
cues.zh: 因此，又找到一個相對小、卻能大幅改變結果的變更。

cues.en: Often, you don't just want to test different recommendation algorithms, you want to test different variations and parameters on those algorithms.
cues.zh: 你通常不只想測試不同推薦演算法，也想測試同一演算法的不同變形與參數。

cues.en: In this case, I not only want to test the idea of using a threshold instead of a top K approach, I'd also want to test many different threshold values to find the best one.
cues.zh: 這個例子中，不只要測試以門檻取代 Top-K 的想法，也想測試許多不同門檻值，找出最好的一個。

cues.en: In the real world, you'll find that your biggest problem is just not having enough time to run all of the different experiments you want to run to make your recommendations better.
cues.zh: 真實世界中，最大的問題通常是時間不足，無法執行所有想做、用來改善推薦的實驗。
